category_title: Adolescents with ADHD exhibiting low levels of agency, chronic procrastination, and disorganized academic behaviors
scenario_title: Reviewing disorganized notebooks and incomplete homework
minimal_context: The tutor and student are reviewing the student's backpack, notebooks, and agendas during a one-on-one session to find and complete homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start by checking your agenda and notebook to see what homework assignments we need to work on today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have my agenda. Agendas—I just find this is one more thing to lose.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, let's just look through your notebook to find your notes and assignments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Like … I write everything down, I just don’t keep it organized. … Like, it’s not in order of date, in order of anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look in your backpack and pull out whatever homework sheets you have so we can do them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Like, there’s sheets ripped out, crumpled up in the bottom of my backpack. I have something against it! It’s just … that’s one thing I hate. … You go to school for six hours and they give you homework that lasts another six. … I hate homework so much. … It’s the most meaningless thing in the world. I just … don’t do it!

task.content: Maintaining and organizing notebooks and binders for school subjects, and completing homework assignments

context.environment: clinical interview or tutoring session where students brought their materials

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: what teachers would look for when checking notebooks (e.g., completeness, dated pages, neatness, titles, underlining) and agenda use
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: notebooks were disorganized, sheets ripped out, crumpled up in the bottom of backpack, lost their agendas
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Agendas—I just find this is one more thing to lose

behavior_patterns.condition: Completing homework assignments outside of school hours
